title: Zigbee links
toggle: Show Zigbee links when hovering over a device
hint: Shows parents and next hops reported by the integration. Nothing is fetched while you hover.
help: Shows an end device's parent or a router's active next hop to the coordinator, as reported by the integration. There is at most one outgoing arrow; incoming arrows identify devices routing through this node. Ordinary neighbours are hidden. All lines are solid. Line and arrow colour use LQI 0–255: red at 0, yellow at 128, green at 255. Without LQI they are grey with a black outline. A label at the end names a target on another space or not on the plan. No route data means that no outgoing route was reported unambiguously, not that the device is offline. These are last-received integration records, not a live packet trace or a guarantee of the whole path. Cached ZHA tables may already be old when read; stale and incomplete snapshots are marked. Links are shown with a mouse only.
admin_only: Topology data is available to Home Assistant administrators only.
save_first: Save this setting before loading topology data.

incomplete_provider_unavailable: ZHA marked the node unavailable. This is a source report, not a diagnosis of a faulty device.
incomplete_unmatched_device: The node could not be matched unambiguously to a marker on the plan.
incomplete_registry_missing: No matching device was found in the HA registry.
incomplete_registry_ambiguous: The node matches several HA devices; the mapping is ambiguous.

incomplete_route_conflict: The reported outgoing routes conflict with each other.
incomplete_route_unresolved: The route or next-hop address could not be resolved unambiguously; details of the missing or limited data are unavailable.

incomplete_route_unknown_role: The source did not identify the node role.
incomplete_provider_partial: The source marked the data incomplete without providing details.
incomplete_stage_unknown: The source did not identify all failed stages.
incomplete_refresh_error: The last refresh failed; the reasons above describe the retained snapshot. {error}
